name: Locust
overview: The Scripture presents locusts as a powerful instrument of God's judgment, vividly demonstrated in the plague sent upon Egypt when God declared He would bring locusts to cover the land so thoroughly that the earth would be obscured and all remaining vegetation consumed. This event, recorded in Exodus 10, highlights God's sovereign control over nature to accomplish His purposes and serves as a sign for future generations to recognize the LORD's authority. Additionally, the Bible acknowledges locusts as an authorized and used food source, though their overwhelming presence can bring devastation, making them both a literal and symbolic element within Scripture.
